title: MEASURING FREE-FORM DECISION-MAKING INCONSISTENCY OF LANGUAGE MODELS IN MILITARY CRISIS SIMULATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Anonymizing explicit country names in the wargame prompts (replacing them with color names) and comparing the model's decision-making inconsistency to prompts with explicit real-world country names to detect underlying biases pertaining to specific nations.
Reversing the presentation order of options (from least escalatory to most escalatory) in a multiple-choice ranking task to evaluate how option ordering affects the model's response inconsistency.
